estimates.rationale: Foundational slice: new stock schema with unique (sku, location), full boundary/service/repository layering, filing form with inline validation, and empty-state -> index/detail render end to end.
Reuses FP1's stock model/layers; adds an adjust action with in-place optimistic update and below-zero rejection , constrained delta on an existing row.
New supplier-attributed inbound receipt event plus supplier reference, receipt form, confirmation, and increment of target stock , a distinct write path beyond a bare adjustment.
Outbound pick draw-down with transactional no-overcommit enforcement at write time and inline shortfall rejection , business-rule and concurrency care raise it above a plain form.
Largely a read/aggregation slice over existing multi-row stock: a SKU detail view listing every location row; leans on FP1's model with little new write surface.
